frozen_mean_model: Source-only conditional selection per mean head, then the common eight paid initial observations; identical mean predictions and uncertainties for all risk arms and all later checkpoints. No post-initial mean labels enter recommendations or acquisition.
known_means_diagnostic: Exact objective and constraint means are deliberately supplied to every risk arm as an idealized diagnostic. Target log variance is withheld. This is not a deployable method or full-method performance evidence.
risk_arms: Target-only full dictionary; same-source fixed dictionary; source-learned risk covariance; paid-target mixture of source risk covariance and same-source fixed dictionary; support-only oracle fitted on the same sources without target coefficients or target risk values.
acquisition: Three-node one-head Gaussian-fantasy KG for the same predeclared verification utility, updating risk covariance and leaving the fixed means unchanged. Moment-match mixture; hold model weights fixed inside fantasies and update them on paid observations.
verification_utility: Failed verification earns zero; accepted deployment earns clip((5-f)/10,0,1). Unchanged 256-repeat Gaussian t/chi-square verifier. Mathematical feasibility and objective regret are also retained.
budget_curve: Every trajectory runs all 80 batches. Intermediate recommendations are scored at predeclared prefixes, not used as truth-aware stopping. One checkpoint deployment costs its search prefix plus a separate 256-repeat verifier. The shared validation stream across checkpoints is paired diagnostic evidence, not independent confirmations.
primary_comparisons: risk_ard versus fixed_source on binding shared_structure at 24 batches in each mean context
risk_ard_mixture versus fixed_source on the same tasks
oracle_structure versus fixed_source diagnoses whether learning risk support has remaining decision opportunity
fixed_source versus target_only separates any-source information from structural learning
secondary_analysis: Report all five mechanisms, both layers and all budget checkpoints. Report expected verified reward, true finite-bank shortfall, local verifier-power error, risk RMSE/coverage and realized independent verification. Report integrated shortfall across fixed checkpoints, not only the winning final budget.
analysis_units: Sixteen paired seed blocks; checkpoints, mean contexts, difficulty layers, arms and candidates are not independent samples. No task filtering by truth, feasibility or apparent risk relevance.
scope: Risk attribution in the unchanged V3 generator and candidate count. No added hardness, changed verification budget, trajectory encoder, factor-level HVD or continuous-search guarantee. Old V1/V2/V3 evidence and sealed 2025 data remain unchanged.
stopping_rule: Complete the frozen matrix once. If the support oracle has no added decision value, treat the risk mechanism as unnecessary for this task family; do not retune offsets or select favorable tasks to make it win.
